selectLanguageDescription: Khetha ulwimi loqubo lokuFaka nolwimi olungagqibekanga lwesiza.
verifyRequirementsDescription: Khangela ukuba imeko yeseva yakho ihlangabezana neemfuno zokuqhuba i-HAX.
allRequirementsMet: Zonke iimfuno zihlangabezene. Ungaqhubeka kumzila olandelayo.
configureSystemDescription: Misa i-akhawunti yakho yomphathi wesiza esitsha se-HAX.
passwordHelp: Shiya kube singenalutho ukufumana i-password ekhuselekileyo ezenziwe ngokuzenzekelayo, okanye faka iimpawu ezili-10+ ezineeleta ezinye kunye nenani elinye.
installationComplete: UkuFaka kuphumelele! Nantsi iinkcukacha zakho zogqino.
saveCredentialsWarning: Balulekile: Gcina ezi nkcukacha zogqino ngoku. Le yixesha elinye kuphela ezakuboniswa ngalo.
languageHelp: Chwetheza igama, igama lomthonyama okanye ikhowudi.
usernameHelp: Oonobumba, amanani, ichaphaza, idashi kunye nomgca ongezantsi.
versionAfterSignIn: Uguqulelo lwe-HAXcms neendlela ezipheleleyo zeseva ziboniswa kulawulo lwenkqubo emva kokungena.
foreverFiles: Iisayithi zakho ziifayile eziqhelekileyo kwi-_sites, zilandelelwa nge-git ukusukela kusuku lokuqala.
foreverStandards: Yakhelwe kwimigangatho yewebhu, ngoko into oyenzayo iqhubeka isebenza njengoko i-HAXcms ihlaziywa.
foreverPortable: Thatha isayithi naphi na: isebenza kwi-HAXcms ku-PHP okanye ku-Node, okanye njengeefayile ezimileyo.
tvArtCredit: Ubugcisa be-Future Traveler busuka kwi-haxtheweb/art. I-TV ijongeka ngokufanayo ekukhanyeni nasebumnyameni.
padNote: Iibhloko ze-HAX kwijelo 2: khuphisana nabachasi abathathu ngeebhloko ze-HAX. A iyabamba (okanye ibethe umchasi osecaleni kwakho), B ibuyisa enye, Select iyila kwakhona umlwi wakho, Start iyapapasha. Ikhibhodi yakho nayo iyasebenza: iintolo, A no-B zikhanyisa iqhosha ezilicinezelayo.
tipDifferenceTitle: Umahluko we-HAX: into oyenzayo iqhubeka isebenza
tipDifference: Amaphepha akho yi-HTML yomgangatho wewebhu kwiifayile eziqhelekileyo ozingumniniyo, zilandelelwa nge-git. Phantse yonke isayithi eyakhiwe nge-HAX ukusukela ngo-2020 isasebenza namhlanje, kwaye isayithi ihamba phakathi kwe-HAXcms ku-PHP, ku-Node okanye ukubamba okumileyo njengoko injalo. Yakhelwe ukuhlala, ilula kwiplanethi.
tipFiles: Emva kofakelo, u-Ngenisa kwideshibhodi uzijika zibe yisayithi ye-HAX onokuyihlela, uyidibanise kwakhona kwaye uyithathe naphi na.
tipSites: Khombisa u-Ngenisa kwidilesi yesayithi kwaye amaphepha ayo angena njengamaphepha neebhloko ze-HAX.
tipBooks: Iincwadi zokufunda ezivulekileyo noovimba be-docs-as-code baba yisayithi ye-HAX umgca wesiqulatho wazo ungaphazamiseki.
tipPassword: Inyathelo lokugqibela libonisa ukungena kwakho okutsha kube kanye. Kugcine kumlawuli wamagama okugqitha ngaphambi kokuba uqalise i-HAXcms.
